encoded_published_rule: AGENTS.md#6: Exit 2 (block) only for irreversible/dangerous work. Exit 0 + inject for all other guidance. All hook code wrapped in try/except; any hook error exits 0 (fail-open). Validators, secret gates, and signature checks are not hooks: they deny on error. Changing a row is owner-gated (_USER-PROMPTS.md:11359).

owner_lock.note: This table records the published rule. It does not invent a new security posture. Flipping any row remains owner-gated.

components.rationale: Hooks must never block the user. A raising or unparseable hook still exits 0 and the session proceeds, degraded.
Advisories inject context; they are not a hard stop. Failure to emit an advisory must not refuse the operation.
The degrade-loudly sink is a warning channel. A write failure must not convert a warning into a blocked user.
A heartbeat is a liveness surface. Failure to advance a token must not abort the long-running operation.
An unverifiable package or config must not proceed. Validator errors deny.
A leaked credential is unrecoverable once published. Gate errors deny.
An invalid or missing signature must refuse the operation, never skip the check.
Shipping unintended content is deny-by-default. Allowlist errors deny.
Forbidden-content detection that cannot complete must deny rather than ship.
Undeclared writes, spawns, or network calls are refused. Permission-check errors deny.
A rollback that cannot invert applied steps must not report success. Errors deny.
